name: Ip2_JCFpmMat_JCFpmMat_JCFpmPhys
description: Converts 2 JCFpmMat instances to one JCFpmPhys instance, with corresponding parameters. See JCFpmMat and [Duriez2016]_ for details

attributes.name: cohesiveTresholdIteration
attributes.description: should new contacts be cohesive? If strictly negativ, they will in any case. If positiv, they will before this iter, they won't afterward.

attributes.name: xSectionWeibullShapeParameter
attributes.description: Shape parameter used to generate interaction radii for the crossSectional areas (changing strength criteria only) according to Weibull distribution. Activated for any value other than 0. Needs to be combined with a

attributes.name: xSectionWeibullScaleParameter
attributes.description: Scale parameter used to generate interaction radii for the crosssectional areas (changing strength criteria only) according to Weibull distribution. Activated for any value other than 0. Needs to be combined with a

attributes.name: weibullCutOffMin
attributes.description: Factor that cuts off the smallest values of the weibull distributed interaction areas.

attributes.name: weibullCutOffMax
attributes.description: Factor that cuts off the largest values of the weibull distributed interaction areas.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.
